tagline: Every month with you is my favorite chapter.
intro_text: I made a small website for you my Luv!
letter: Happy 11th Month, Thank you for everything and I'm so grateful na ikaw akong na girlfriend and soon to be my wife kay you're the one who makes my life complete and ikaw para mag save sa akoa luv when i hit the rock bottom.
Thank you for every laugh, every late-night talk, and every moment we share. Being with you feels like home.

My luv, I'm really sorry for what i did and you don't deserve that kind of pain. Also, I'm sorry i disappointed you and nag padala sa akong nafeel that night. I'll do everything to gain your trust back and mabalik ang datin i know dugay pa but I will wait for you luv and I'll be patient. God knows gaano nko kagusto na ikaw akong mapaasawa and maging inahan sa akong mga anak, God knows unsa taka ka Love baby and yes nagkamali ko pero I reassure you na dli nayun mauulit. Let's enjoy our day and make more memories together.
I love you, today and always.

moments.caption: The day gehatud tka sainyo na nag motor us and that day is na hooked gyud ko and want maka motor kay nindot sa feeling na mahatid sundo taka luv.
I feel so welcomed luv pag abot sa venue and ge asikaso dayun gyud ko pero ulaw at the same time kay nakaabala pa and naay away slight dahil sa akoa hehe
THis moment is special and first time mka feel og ing ato na happiness kay nahatud tka gamit car nnyo hehe
This moment is special and first time mka feel og ing ato na happiness kay nahatud tka gamit car nnyo hehe
Of course, our first investment as a couple. I'm so thankful luv kay dahil saimo nagkaroon ko og ing ana na investment na pati ako wala ka tou sa ing ani na edad

reasons: Your smile makes my whole day better.
You make me want to be better.
You're always there for me and I love that.
footer: Made with love, just for you.
